scope: Instantaneous PM4Sand3D Section 2 flow direction only, using the pinned surface algebra; D is supplied. No evolution law for D, stress/history update, initialization, host averaging, calibration or material integration.

dependencies.relationship: First seven terms are exactly the existing surface fragment.

r.meaning: Deviatoric effective stress ratio; Mandel order xx, yy, zz, sqrt(2)xy, sqrt(2)yz, sqrt(2)xz

alpha.meaning: Deviatoric back-stress ratio in the same convention as r

c.meaning: Extension/compression shape ratio; supplied here, not the evolving default calibration

D.meaning: Supplied volumetric coefficient in R=Rdev+D I/3; not an extracted complete dilatancy law.

audit_domain.policy: Inherited surface audit scope only. D bounds and full physical admissibility are not selected. No Lode clipping, zero-direction floor or flow normalization is added.
additional_requirements: D is a finite real scalar; both signs and zero permitted in this algebra audit.
